message.content: {"action":"done","summary":"Constitution phase complete. Wrote /testbed/.specify/memory/constitution.md (v1.0.0, Ratified/Last Amended 2026-10-16) using the resolved constitution-template (via .specify/scripts/python/resolve_template.py, which succeeded). All five supplied principles are encoded as declarative, MUST-based, testable rules: I. Preserve Existing Public API Behavior (incl. 'do not modify TinyDB'), II. Testable Acceptance Criteria, III. Evidence Over Assertion, IV. Simple Scoped Implementations (no service/deployment; single small module), V. Documented Assumptions and Regressions. Added concise 'Scope and Non-Goals' and 'Development Workflow' sections scoped to smoke.py/add(a,b) under specs/001-transactions; Governance section defines amendment procedure, semver policy, and phase-boundary compliance review. A temporary Sync Impact Report HTML comment sits at the top (version 0.0.0 scaffold -> 1.0.0, modified/added/removed sections, no deferred TODOs) and is flagged for removal before commit. Validation evidenced by command output: no remaining [ALL_CAPS] bracket tokens, no trailing whitespace, version line matches report, ISO dates. No .specify/extensions.yml exists, so no pre/post hooks were checked or run. Scope guard honored: only the constitution file was written; no application source, tests, or template layers touched. Suggested commit: 'docs: adopt project constitution v1.0.0 (five core principles + governance)'. Next Actions (deferred non-governance intents, not executed): R01 'create smoke.py with add(a,b) returning a+b' and R02 'support negative integers, zero and floats' and R03 'add and run tests' -> proceed to $speckit-specify (then $speckit-plan, $speckit-tasks, $speckit-implement) in specs/001-transactions."}
